caption: The drawing depicts a metal oil can with a cylindrical body, a wide circular base, and a narrow cylindrical neck that extends into a tapered spout. The can has a single curved handle attached to one side. The surface of the can is rendered in shades of gray, with areas of brownish and rusty discoloration, giving the appearance of aged or weathered metal. The background is plain and light-colored, framed by a rectangular border lightly drawn around the can. At the bottom of the drawing, the text “SCALE EXACT SIZE” appears on the left and “FRANK MAURER” is written on the right.
title: Wick Lamp
